questions.question: Calculate the average home team goal in the 2010/2011 season in the country of Poland.
questions.evidence: average home team fld148 = AVG(fld080)= SUM(fld080) / COUNT(DISTINCT tab07.fld001) WHERE fld048 = 'Poland' and fld075 = '2010/2011';
questions.SQL: SELECT CAST(SUM(t2.fld080) AS REAL) / COUNT(t2.fld001) FROM tab04 AS t1 INNER JOIN tab07 AS t2 ON t1.fld001 = t2.fld047 WHERE t1.fld048 = 'Poland' AND t2.fld075 = '2010/2011'
questions.SQL_original: SELECT CAST(SUM(t2.home_team_goal) AS REAL) / COUNT(t2.id) FROM Country AS t1 INNER JOIN Match AS t2 ON t1.id = t2.country_id WHERE t1.name = 'Poland' AND t2.season = '2010/2011'

questions.question: List the top 10 players' names whose heights are above 180 in descending order of average heading accuracy.

questions.question: Give the name of the league had the most matches end as draw in the 2016 season?

questions.question: What is the percentage of players that are under 180 cm who have an overall strength of more than 70?

questions.SQL_original: SELECT CAST(COUNT(CASE WHEN t2.overall_rating > 70  AND t1.height < 180 THEN t1.id ELSE NULL END) AS REAL) * 100 / COUNT(t1.id) percent FROM Player AS t1 INNER JOIN Player_Attributes AS t2 ON t1.player_api_id = t2.player_api_id

questions.question: For the players who had a 77 points overall rating on 2016/6/23, who was the oldest? Give the name of the player.

questions.SQL_original: SELECT t1.player_name FROM Player AS t1 INNER JOIN Player_Attributes AS t2 ON t1.player_api_id = t2.player_api_id WHERE SUBSTR(t2.`date`, 1, 10) = '2016-06-23' AND t2.overall_rating = 77 ORDER BY t1.birthday ASC LIMIT 1

questions.question: Calculate the percentage of players who prefer left foot, who were born between 1987 and 1992.
questions.evidence: players who prefer left foot refers to fld007 = 'left'; percentage of players who prefer left foot = DIVIDE(MULTIPLY((SUM(fld007 = 'left'), 100)), COUNT(fld002)); born between 1987 and 1992 refers to YEAR(fld044) BETWEEN '1987' AND '1992';
questions.SQL: SELECT CAST(COUNT(CASE WHEN t2.fld007 = 'left' THEN t1.fld001 ELSE NULL END) AS REAL) * 100 / COUNT(t1.fld001) AS percent FROM tab02 AS t1 INNER JOIN tab01 AS t2 ON t1.fld003 = t2.fld003 WHERE SUBSTRING(t1.fld044, 1, 4) BETWEEN '1987' AND '1992'
questions.SQL_original: SELECT CAST(COUNT(CASE WHEN t2.preferred_foot = 'left' THEN t1.id ELSE NULL END) AS REAL) * 100 / COUNT(t1.id) percent FROM Player AS t1 INNER JOIN Player_Attributes AS t2 ON t1.player_api_id = t2.player_api_id WHERE SUBSTR(t1.birthday, 1, 4) BETWEEN '1987' AND '1992'

questions.question: At present, calculate for the player's age who have a sprint speed of no less than 97 between 2013 to 2015.
questions.evidence: players age at present = SUBTRACT((DATETIME(), fld044)); sprint speed of no less than 97 refers to fld021 > = 97; between 2013 to 2015 refers to YEAR(fld004) > = '2013' AND YEAR(fld004) < = '2015';
questions.SQL: SELECT DISTINCT DATETIME() - T2.fld044 AS age FROM tab01 AS t1 INNER JOIN tab02 AS t2 ON t1.fld003 = t2.fld003 WHERE STRFTIME('%Y', t1.fld004) >= '2013' AND STRFTIME('%Y', t1.fld004) <= '2015' AND t1.fld021 >= 97
questions.SQL_original: SELECT DISTINCT DATETIME() - T2.birthday age FROM Player_Attributes AS t1 INNER JOIN Player AS t2 ON t1.player_api_id = t2.player_api_id WHERE STRFTIME('%Y',t1.`date`) >= '2013' AND STRFTIME('%Y',t1.`date`) <= '2015' AND t1.sprint_speed >= 97

questions.question: How much higher in percentage is Ariel Borysiuk's overall rating than that of Paulin Puel?

questions.question: List the name of leagues in which the average goals by the home team is higher than the away team in the 2009/2010 season.
questions.evidence: name of league refers to tab03.fld048; average goals by the home tab05 is higher than the away tab05 = AVG(fld080) > AVG(fld081); AVG(xx_goal) = SUM(xx_goal) / COUNT(DISTINCT tab07.fld001); 2009/2010 season refers to fld075 = '2009/2010'
questions.SQL: SELECT t1.fld048 FROM tab03 AS t1 INNER JOIN tab07 AS t2 ON t1.fld001 = t2.fld074 WHERE t2.fld075 = '2009/2010' GROUP BY t1.fld048 HAVING (CAST(SUM(t2.fld080) AS REAL) / COUNT(DISTINCT t2.fld001)) - (CAST(SUM(t2.fld081) AS REAL) / COUNT(DISTINCT t2.fld001)) > 0
questions.SQL_original: SELECT t1.name FROM League AS t1 INNER JOIN Match AS t2 ON t1.id = t2.league_id WHERE t2.season = '2009/2010' GROUP BY t1.name HAVING (CAST(SUM(t2.home_team_goal) AS REAL) / COUNT(DISTINCT t2.id)) - (CAST(SUM(t2.away_team_goal) AS REAL) / COUNT(DISTINCT t2.id)) > 0
